title: Tuas port, integrated treatment and West Region gain named accounts
summary: Three dated readings distinguish port operation and construction, water–waste integration and regional planning. Eligible identities reach 72 projects and 37 places; these are not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Fifteen primary-source records inspected November 22. November 10 reclamation and November 20 terminal construction retain distinct dates. Cumulative TEUs, future capacities, treatment design rates, another site's pilot and district-level planning targets keep their respective scopes.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
